name: ritual
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Make a production sprite sheet with TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Image 1 is the exact layout and shape guide to paint. Preserve transparent gaps. Do not show grid lines, labels or wireframe outlines. Cool blue-violet slate, intricate natural fractures and mineral edges, selective olive and gold lichen, cushion moss in crevices, readable lighting, painterly volume. Fine irregular natural details replace the schematic internal straight lines; retain overall silhouette. Consistent cool moonlight from upper left, modest warm amber accents from low front. No characters, no scene background, no floor sheet, no additional objects in empty cells. Keep native transparency. Image 1 contains exactly SEVEN isolated sprites on a 3x3 sheet, row-major: first a low stepped round ritual dais, then SIX carved stone pillars. Last two cells empty. Preserve the EYE IN DIAMOND sigil, branching tips, and six distinct lower runes, NOT spirals. As in reference 2, weathered violet stone, delicate old bronze/gold bands, carved beveled edges, rich natural cracks, aged matte gold inlay in the sigils, moss gathered at bases. Dais top is cracked purple-grey rock, gold inlaid eye seal and thin ring, gold patina on stepped rims, tiny moss in cracks. Do not add candles to this sheet. No glowing magic, only gentle warm reflections. Pillar caps different as in guide; all six individual, not duplicates. Keep dais exactly flattened isometric ellipse as guide.
